caveats: Shared-core diagnostic times are not performance evidence.
Direct and cached sector Lanczos preserve original-pencil residual/rank checks and exact inertia certification.
Every cached factor keeps its actual shift; no global state survives a candidate-construction call.
Cache budget divides remaining allowance across every sector; original factor memory checks remain active.
The zero-filter option declines this optimization and takes the ordinary path.
Outer factor statistics exclude inner sector solves; their costs remain in parent time_total_s/time_iterate_s and detailed stderr records.
The two physical photonic inputs have incomplete external references.
No sparse matrix is densified by the solver. Dense full-spectrum references are only for small tests of order <=420.
The initial budget checker failed before compilation because its link-object assumption was wrong; budget_check_v2 fixes only the harness. Both records are retained.

The initial extra test requested k=20 beyond the recognizer size guard (32<44), so all three correct solves used the ordinary path and its coverage assertion failed. v2 requests k=14 within the guard, forcing all initial sectors to expand.
Frozen private native libraries require previous P33-P38 dependencies; production P29 remains unchanged.
